title: Effective Federal Funds Rate
revision_note: FRED's H.15 monthly average is not revised after publication.

inputs.label: Effective Federal Funds Rate, monthly average

methodology: The effective federal funds rate is the volume-weighted median of overnight federal funds transactions, published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and reported here as the Board of Governors' monthly average, FRED series FEDFUNDS.
Monthly average since FRED's series starts (1954-07); no daily series is upsampled to fill it.
notes: Values are percent (5.33 means 5.33%), not a decimal fraction.
FRED dates a monthly observation to the first of the month it covers (e.g. 2026-08-01 is the August 2026 average).

presentation.summary: Monthly effective federal funds rate back to 1954, from FRED.
